showcase.title: U7 Same/Near Order Reuse Showcase
showcase.playerPerspective: Use Select Reuse Squad, then right-click the same destination twice and a nearby destination once. Repeated or nearby RTS commands must reuse a normalized route bucket and route id instead of solving duplicate paths.
showcase.modAuthorPerspective: Validate command bucketing and cache signatures before scaling RTS orders; one player click should not trigger redundant large-world path solves.
